content: वचनम् [वच्-ल्युट्] .²1 The act of speaking, uttering. saying. .²2 Speech, an utterance, words (spoken), sentence; ननु वक्तृविशेषनिःस्पृहा गुणगृह्या वचने विपश्चितः <ls>Ki. 2. 5</ls>; प्रीतः प्रीतिप्रमुखवचनं स्वागतं व्याजहार <ls>Me. 4</ls>. .²3 Repeating, recitation. .²4 A text, dictum, rule, precept, a passage of a sacred book; शास्त्रवचनम्, श्रुतिवचनम्, स्मृतिवचनम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 An order, a command, direction; शुश्रूषां गौरवं चैव प्रमाणं वचनक्रियाम् (कुर्यात्) <ls>Rām. 2. 12. 26</ls>; मद्वचनात् ‘in my name’, ‘by my order’. .²6 Advice, counsel, instruction. .²7 Declaration, affirmation. .²8 Pronunciation (of a letter) (in <ab>gram.</ab>). .²9 The signification or meaning of a word; अत्र पयोधरशब्दः मेघवचनः. .²10 Number (in <ab>gram.</ab>); (there are three numbers, singular, dual and plural). .²11 Dry ginger.
